Edit Mountain, Mine (main), Mine 20/60/100, Quarry Mine, and adds a new area with an abandoned mine.
There is a working minecart in the deepest part of the abandoned mine.

The Dwarf now sells prismatic shards for 10,000


It should be compatible with east scarp

I didn't test it, but most likely no.

no

maybe. I can look into it and see if it's possible.
